mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing a light drizzle and 62 degrees at Verona City Hall, with an air quality index of 54 currently elevated in the moderate range.

The City of Verona Common Council recently voted unanimously to adopt the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a long-range roadmap for city development, housing, and sustainable growth over the next decade.
There is plenty to do in town with live music at Bailey's Run today, and you can look forward to the Dane County Farmer's Market and the Puppets in the Park festival taking place tomorrow.
In a notable incident from the weekly report, on October 3, an officer conducted a traffic stop that led to the arrest of a 19-year-old man and the recovery of a stolen firearm.
